verdict.rationale: Metorial documents a catalog of 1200+ integrations spanning SaaS tools, enterprise systems, data sources, and custom MCP servers (metorial-gh-2), backed by docs on pre-built providers, OAuth-based connections (Slack, GitHub, Google Calendar), remote MCP linking, and custom provider uploads, giving broad reach beyond just the native catalog. Community feedback confirms real developers compare it against competitors like Composio specifically on integration breadth, corroborating the catalog's existence outside vendor claims. missing for 10: independent verification of the exact 1200+ count, and no hands-on report cataloguing breadth/quality across many specific integrations.
